simple.meaning: properly, to be bald , i.e. (causatively) to shave ; figuratively to lay waste
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּלַח (H1548) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 23 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גָּלַח (gâlach) means properly, to be bald , i.e. (causatively) to shave ; figuratively to lay waste First listed occurrence: 1Chr 19 4.

definitions.short: properly, to be bald , i.e. (causatively) to shave ; figuratively to lay waste
definitions.full: H1548. galach [ גָּלַח ] verb be bald (Arabic ); Pi`el shave, shave off (so Late Hebrew, Aramaic) — Perfect וְגִלַּח consecutive Lev 14:8 2 t.; suffix וְגִלְּחוֺ consecutive 2Sam 14:26 ; 3 feminine singular וְגִלְּחָה consecutive Deut 21:12 ; Imperfect יְגַלַּח Lev 14:9 ; Isa 7:20 , יְגַלֵּחַ֑ Lev 13:33 2 t., וַיְגַלַּח Gen 41:14 ; 2Sam 10:4 ; suffix (3masculine singular) וַיְגַלְּחֵם יְגַלְּחֶגּוּ, 1Chr 19:4 ; 3 feminine singular וַתְּנַלַּךְ Judg 16:19 ; 3 masculine plural יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ Lev 21:5 ; Ezek 44:20 ; Infinitive suffix of subject גַּלְּחוֺ 2Sam 14:26 ; — 1 shave , object the head, ראֹשׁ Num 6:9 (twice in verse); 6:18 (P) Deut 21:12 (hair as containing impurity, compare RS Sem i. 407 ), 2Sam 14:26 (twice in verse) compare; 14:26 ; Ezek 44:20 ; Lev 13:33 (P), object הַנֶתֶק ; object persons 1Chr 19:4 . 2 shave off , the hair שֵׂעָר Lev 14:8-9 , (twice in verse) (P) compare Judg 16:19 ; the beard זָקָן Lev 21:5 (H) 2Sam 10:4 . 3 figurative of devastation by Assyrians Isa 7:20 (object הָרַגְלָ֑יִם שַׂעַר הָראֹשׁ, and הַזָּקָן ). 4 intransitive he shaved (himself) Gen 41:14 (E). Pu`al Perfect גֻּלָּ֑ח Judg 16:22 , גֻּלַּחְתִּי 16:17 ; Participle construct מְגֻלְּחֵי Jer 41:5 ; — be shaven , subject person (of Samson) Judg 16:17 , 22 ; זָקָן מְגֻלְּחֵי Jer 41:5 . Hithpa`el Perfect וְהִתְגַּלָּ֑ח consecutive Lev 13:33 ; Infinitive suffix הִתְגַּלְּחוֺ Num 6:19 ; — shave oneself Lev 13:33 ; with accusative אֶתנִֿזְרוֺ Num 6:19 (both P). I. גלל ( be great in rank or dignity (often of God)).
